Therefore, several case studies of representative expected utilization characteristics were developed for illustration. 14.6 Marketing Plan 14.6.1 Goal The ultimate goal is to ensure MTV compatibility, availability, and affordability for the U.S. marine energy sector during the next 20 years. Final Technical Report 53/57 To achieve this ultimate goal, the following objectives have been set: • Customer objectives: gain awareness, ensure alignment, and foster use by marine energy equipment developers. • Collaborator objectives: ensure data availability, supply chain access, and promotional support • Internal objectives: achieve full cost recovery • Competitive objectives: focus marketing efforts on attracting customers that would otherwise use existing test centers or independently field test or demonstrate their marine energy technologies 14.6.2 Strategy A target market, expected customers, collaborators, and competitors were developed. The value proposition the MTV offers is to provide access to open water testing and demonstration opportunities in U.S. commercial locations and markets that CECs are intended for. The MTV will deliver cheaper, faster, and more customized support to CEC developers than the competition. Benefits include: • Credibility: The MTV will offer the tools to perform testing according to international technical standards and provide internationally recognized test results. • Flexibility: CECs of any known configuration are compatible with the MTV, with three possible CEC testing/deployment configurations and three MTV mooring options. • Affordability: The pricing strategy has been carefully designed to ensure that MTV user costs are minimized and are significantly less than alternative offerings. • Comprehensiveness: The MTV design is a self-contained, full-featured platform that can support the full suite of test and demonstration needs for CECs up to the 700 kW class. • Accessibility: The MTV can be transported to be utilized in any U.S. coastal location where marine energy resources are found. • Convenience: By eliminating regulatory requirements for offshore grid interconnection, tests and demonstrations can be performed within months, not years, of project scoping. Several tactics were developed to establish and maintain a full pipeline of MTV users. 14.7 Pricing Strategy It is expected that costs associated with MTV utilization and its cost of ownership will be passed on to MTV users. No separate fund will be available to either partially or fully subsidize it. As a result, the initial pricing strategy will combine direct variable costs to be borne by the user and fixed costs as a day rate through an FAU-established recharge cost center. So that federal and other public funds can be used, the recharge center will be established following federal cost accounting principles8 that FAU is compliant with all its sponsored programs' activities.
